headline: GOLD DROPS TO $4,620 AS JULY PCE BEATS AT +0.2% — ANNUAL RATE 3.7% KEEPS HAWKISH DOOR OPEN BEFORE WARSH
snippet: Gold pulled back from its three-month high of $4,697 to around $4,620 after July PCE inflation printed at +0.2% month-over-month (vs +0.1% forecast) and 3.7% annually versus 3.6% expected, keeping Fed optionality alive. Markets now look to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole address Friday as the next major catalyst.

headline: SPROTT BETS $2M ON STORM EXPLORATION'S VMS TARGET — ENTIRE OFFERING TAKEN, 3,000m DRILL START IMMINENT
snippet: A corporation controlled by Eric Sprott has subscribed for the entirety of Storm Exploration's (TSXV:STRM) $2 million private placement at $0.40/unit, becoming its largest shareholder. Proceeds fund up to 3,000 metres of drilling at the Gold Standard Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide target.

headline: LEGACY GOLD WIDENS BANER MAIN ZONE TO 310m IN IDAHO — 0.39 g/t Au OVER 61m FROM JUST 15m BELOW SURFACE
snippet: Phase 2 drilling at the Baner Gold Mine in Idaho County has expanded the Main Zone to approximately 310 metres (1,020 feet) in width, with RC hole LG26-021 returning 0.67 g/t Au over 15.2m and a broad bulk-tonnage intersection of 0.39 g/t Au over 61.0m beginning only 15 metres below surface. Mineralization remains open in all directions.

headline: GLOBEX MINING DRILLS 4,800m IN 11 HOLES ALONG CADILLAC SHEAR — BETWEEN AGNICO AND IAMGOLD MINES IN QUEBEC
snippet: Globex Mining Enterprises has launched a 4,800-metre, 11-hole drill program on its 100%-owned Wood/Central Cadillac property along the Larder Lake-Cadillac Shear Zone, 45km from Rouyn-Noranda. The land package sits between Agnico Eagle's LaRonde and IAMGOLD's Westwood mines, targeting historic gold mineralization with two active rigs.

headline: ALBEMARLE -5.89%, SQM -3.79% AS GUANGZHOU FUTURES REVERSE — LITHIUM RALLY SNAPPED IN SINGLE SESSION
snippet: The LIT ETF fell 0.57% to $76.59 on Tuesday as the Guangzhou Futures Exchange LC2609 lithium contract reversed from an intraday high of 157,980 CNY/t to close at 149,300 CNY/t. Albemarle dropped 5.89% to $133.18 and SQM fell 3.79% to $79.21 — analysts attribute Albemarle's move to an unwind of recent outperformance rather than a fundamental deterioration.

headline: URANIUM SPOT HITS $89.53/LB — BREAKS FIVE-MONTH $84-$87 RANGE AS AI DATA CENTERS ACCELERATE UTILITY BUYING
snippet: Uranium spot reached $89.53/lb today, clearing the five-month trading range of $84–$87 that had persisted since March 2026. AI data-center buildout and China's accelerating nuclear capacity additions are prompting utilities to move earlier on long-term procurement contracts, with term prices already leading spot higher.

headline: LME COPPER STOCKS DOWN 50% SINCE MID-MAY — $6.75/LB HOLDS AS 42-SESSION WAREHOUSE DRAW CONTINUES
snippet: LME copper inventories have fallen nearly 50% since mid-May through a 42-session streak of drawdowns, keeping spot copper anchored at $6.75/lb near its all-time COMEX high. Zijin Mining's warning that Kamoa-Kakula flooding could cut 57,000 tonnes of output this year continues to tighten the physical market.

headline: CHINA HONG KONG GOLD IMPORTS SURGE 11% MOM IN JULY — INVESTMENT DEMAND HOLDS FIRM AT THREE-MONTH PRICE HIGHS
snippet: China's net gold imports through Hong Kong rose approximately 11% month-over-month in July, confirming that Chinese retail and institutional investors continue buying aggressively despite gold touching three-month highs near $4,697. The data counters any thesis that elevated prices are deterring Asian demand.

headline: GOLD MINER STOCKS AT 'LOW-HANGING FRUIT' VALUATIONS — PRODUCERS TRADE AT DISCOUNT DESPITE RECORD $2,800/oz MARGINS
snippet: A Seeking Alpha analysis of the gold and silver miner universe in August 2026 identifies a cohort of producers trading at significant discounts to intrinsic value even as global average all-in sustaining costs decline 5% while gold prices have surged 24%, creating the widest margins in sector history. The author argues operational leverage to gold prices remains substantially underpriced by equities.

headline: WISDOMTREE: GOLD MINERS' CASE BUILDING BENEATH SURFACE — SECOND-BEST QUARTER EVER, STILL TRADING BELOW FAIR VALUE
snippet: WisdomTree's 2026 gold miner outlook argues that the macro tailwind has rarely been stronger — miners are posting near-record quarterly results — yet sector equities trade at below-average multiples. The report notes the paradox of record operating margins alongside underperformance versus spot gold, and identifies this as a potential setup for sustained outperformance.
